name: STAFF III Database: Acutely Induced Myocardial Ischemia ECGs
description: The STAFF III Database is an experimental clinical study recorded at the Charleston Area Medical Center in West Virginia by Lund University, Duke University, and University of Zaragoza. It comprises continuous high-resolution standard 12-lead ECGs recorded from 104 patients undergoing elective percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA). Balloon inflations produced controlled, acutely induced regional myocardial ischemia lasting up to several minutes. The collection captures pre-inflation, peak inflation, and post-deflation reperfusion ECG states, offering in vivo human data for studying the spatio-temporal evolution of acute ischemic cardiac injury.
